_comment: Phase 0 benchmark. Each entry: paraphrase FAMILY (grow freely), the owner agent, the JSON answer field(s), a truth spec resolved at scoring time from the fixed dataset (never a hardcoded value), a match rule, and guardrail tokens. Rollouts run in AUTO mode (real classifier) so routing (0.20) is scored honestly alongside answer/schema/guardrail. expected_intent is the classifier target for the routing check.
